_readme: ASK RCF ENGLISH - the site guide.
The page is deliberately honest that this is not an AI. A static site
cannot hold an API key safely, so what runs here is a keyword search over
data/assistant.json and the site's search index, entirely in the browser.
Edit the answers in data/assistant.json, then run tools/check-assistant.js
- it verifies every link points at a page that exists, which the build's
own link checker cannot do for links written by JavaScript.

pages.description: Ask a question in plain English and get the page you need, with common ones answered directly. It runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere.

hero.text: Type a question the way you would say it. It will point you at the right page, and answer the common ones directly.

blocks.title: This is a search, not an artificial intelligence
text: It matches the words in your question against written answers and the titles of all 800-odd pages on this site. It does not think, it will not write your essay, and it cannot answer a question about something that is not on this site.

That is a deliberate choice. A genuine AI assistant needs a paid key held on a server, and a key put inside a web page can be read and used by anybody. Until there is somewhere safe to keep one, an honest search is better than a chatbot that guesses.
**Nothing you type is sent anywhere.** It all runs in your own browser, so no question you ask here is recorded, transmitted or seen by anybody.

blocks.heading: What it can and cannot do
text: Worth knowing before you try it, so you are not disappointed by the wrong expectation.
bullets: **It can find a page** from a plain question - *where are the Grade 9 past papers*, *games for grade 6*, *English Day circular*.
**It understands grades.** Put a grade in your question and it will prefer that grade's pages.
**It answers common questions directly** - about the transfer system, the teacher groups, study packs, marking schemes - in a sentence or two, with the links.
**It cannot mark your work,** write an essay, or explain a grammar point it has not been given an answer for.
**It only knows this site.** For anything else, use the full site search or a search engine.
